notes.general_comments:
The overall performance of candidates on this paper was highly commendable. The mean percentage score
of 58.78 was well within the target range. Four of the questions, Questions 2, 7, 6 and 8 turned out to be
rather easy. However, all 30 questions recorded facility scores which were within the test design limits.
There were two Questions, 13 and 29, which had discrimination scores below the test design limit.
